    schools.School,

SELECT 
    "School Name", 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)", 
    "Enrollment (K-12)", 
    ("FRPM Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "Eligibility Rate (%)"
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    "Academic Year" = '2021-2022' AND 
    "School Type" = 'Traditional' AND 
    "District Type" = 'Traditional' AND 
    "County Code" = '059' AND 
    "District Code" = '059000' AND 
    "School Code" = '059000001' AND 
    "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND 
    "District Name" = 'Los Angeles Unified School District' AND 
    "School Name" = 'Los Angeles High School for Math, Science and Engineering'
ORDER BY 
    "Eligibility Rate (%)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

    frpm."School Code",
    frpm."School Name",
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (K-12)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.NumGE1500 / NULLIF(satscores.NumTstTakr, 0) AS "High Scorer Rate"
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Code" = schools."CDSCode"
JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    schools.SOC = '66'
    AND frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
ORDER BY 
    "Eligibility Rate (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT "CDSCode", "CharterNum", AvgScrWrite
FROM (
    SELECT s."CDSCode", s."CharterNum", ss.AvgScrWrite,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
    FROM satscores ss
    JOIN schools s ON ss.cds = s."CDSCode"
    WHERE ss.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s."CharterNum" IS NOT NULL
) AS ranked_schools
ORDER BY rank;

    f."District Name",
    f."County Name",
    f."Eligibility Rate (K-12)",
    s."AvgScrRead",
    s."AvgScrMath",
    s."AvgScrWrite",
    s."NumTstTakr",
    s."NumGE1500",
    (s."NumGE1500" / s."NumTstTakr") AS "High Scorer Rate"
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        "School Name",
        "District Name",
        "County Name",
        "FRPM Count (K-12)",
        "Enrollment (K-12)",
        ("FRPM Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)") AS "Eligibility Rate (K-12)"
     FROM frpm
     JOIN schools ON frpm."CDSCode" = schools."CDSCode"
     WHERE schools."SOC" = '66'
     ORDER BY "Eligibility Rate (K-12)" DESC
     LIMIT 5) f
JOIN satscores s ON f."School Name" = s.sname;

    LEFT(Date, 4) AS Year,
    SUBSTRING(Date FROM 6 FOR 2) AS Month,
    SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM 
    yearmonth
WHERE 
    LEFT(Date, 4) = '2013'
    AND CustomerID IN (
        SELECT 
            CustomerID 
        FROM 
            customers 
        WHERE 
            Segment = 'SME'
    )
GROUP BY 
    LEFT(Date, 4),
    SUBSTRING(Date FROM 6 FOR 2)
ORDER BY 
    TotalConsumption DESC;

sql:
SELECT AVG(UA) AS "Average UA Index"
FROM (
    WITH NormalUA AS (
        SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.UA, l.Date
        FROM Patient p
        JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
        WHERE 
            (l.UA < 8.0 AND p.SEX = 'M') OR 
            (l.UA < 6.5 AND p.SEX = 'F')
    ),
    LatestLab AS (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
        FROM Laboratory
        GROUP BY ID
    )
    SELECT n.ID, n.SEX, n.UA
    FROM NormalUA n
    JOIN LatestLab l ON n.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.LatestDate = n.Date
) AS LatestNormalUA;
